summary: Lookout on Simmering Ridge near the Jackson-Scioto county line, staffed in the 1930s with CCC crews; listed as gone, with no current site description.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: Russell M. Ramsey to staff the tower, with Wm. J. Simmering as substitute
CCC Camp F-4 at Camp Webster kept lookouts on duty in the tower during fire season
Woods fire between Hope Hollow and Hales Creek near South Webster; the tower could not sight it; 23 CCC enrollees and local residents fought it

evidence.supports: 1934 lookout Russell M. Ramsey, substitute Wm. J. Simmering; tower between South Webster and Oak Hill near county line
evidence.quote: The Simmering Ridge Tower lies between South Webster and Oak Hill close to the county line between Jackson and Scioto counties and will occupied by Russell M. Ramsey, whose substitute is Wm. J. Simmering.

evidence.supports: April 1936 lookouts kept on duty in the tower during fire season
evidence.quote: keeping lookouts on duty in the Simmering ridge fire tower during fire season.

evidence.supports: lookouts spot smoke and report it to camp; a crew is dispatched at once
evidence.quote: Then a crew of men is dispatched at once to the scene of the blaze.

evidence.supports: November 1936 tower could not sight the fire because visibility was poor
evidence.quote: As the visibility was extremely poor, the Lookout Tower at Simmering Ridge, manned by CCC's from the Webster camp, was unable to sight the fire.

evidence.supports: 23 CCC enrollees and local residents battled a fire threatening several homes
evidence.quote: A crew of 23 CCC enrollees from Camp Webster and several local residents battled a woods fire which threatened several homes two miles from South Webster Tuesday.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts entry ends with the word Removed, no date given
Ohio list marks the tower as gone, county given as Scioto
evidence.quote: Simmering Ridge Scioto 38.85122 -82.68677 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1572, OH 18

evidence.supports: register places the site in Jackson County, Ohio

notes_for_editor: County: the register and our record say Jackson County; the Ohio list and the Forest Lookouts heading say Scioto County; the 1934 item says the tower lies near the line. Record county left as Jackson, no correction proposed. No build date, design, height or removal date appears in the sources read. A search snippet (not read, not used) says the Ohio list calls the status Removed (unconfirmed), and a TopoQuest map feature lists a Simmering Lookout Tower in Jackson County. The firelookout.org lo-ohio page named in that snippet returned 404, so its wording is not used.
